applicableAreas: Southeast corner of property near southern property boundary
findings.comment: First mitigation tree in southeast corner is positioned approximately 2.3 feet laterally from the overhead electric distribution line (measured trunk center to conductor). This distance is far below the minimum 15-foot clearance required for non-utility-compatible trees from distribution conductors. However, species of this tree is not identified on the landscape plan, preventing verification of utility compatibility status. If non-utility-compatible, tree placement violates clearance requirement; if utility-compatible, it may be acceptable. Species identification is required to confirm compliance.

applicableAreas: Southeast corner of property near southern property boundary
findings.comment: First mitigation tree in southeast corner is positioned at approximately 2.3 feet laterally from the overhead electric distribution line, well within the 25-foot minimum clearance zone for large trees (mature height 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F). Species identity and mature height cannot be verified from the landscape plan. If this tree is ≥40 feet at maturity, it violates the 25-foot clearance requirement.

applicableAreas: Trees proposed near overhead electric facilities throughout the site, particularly southeast corner
findings.comment: Plant schedule on Sheet 35 lists tree species generically (e.g., Cedar Elm, Live Oak, Mexican Redbud, Texas Mountain Laurel) but does not identify which species are proposed at which specific tree locations shown on the Landscape Plan (Sheet 31). Without species-to-location linkage, utility compatibility status (UC designation per ECM Appendix F) and mature height cannot be verified for trees proposed near overhead electric facilities, preventing compliance verification for clearance requirements.

applicableAreas: Landscape Plan trees near overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: No distance dimensions or callouts are shown on the Landscape Plan indicating clearances from tree locations to the overhead electric line or from tree trunks to utility poles or pad-mounted equipment. Clearance measurement methodology cannot be verified; plans do not demonstrate that measurements are taken from the outside conductor (not pole centerline) as required by UCM § 1.10.10.4.

applicableAreas: Landscape Plan trees near overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: No distance dimensions or callouts on the Landscape Plan indicate whether clearances from trees to utilities are measured from tree trunk centers (planting location) or from projected canopy edges. The visual representation shows tree canopy circles overlapping the overhead electric line, but no dimension callouts demonstrate that measurements comply with the requirement to measure from tree trunk center rather than canopy edge.

applicableAreas: Southeast corner of property near southern property boundary
findings.comment: First mitigation tree proposed at approximately 2.3 feet from the overhead electric distribution line is positioned in a prohibited clearance zone (less than 15 feet, where only utility-compatible trees are permitted by distribution clearance zones). No documented written approval from Austin Energy is visible on the submitted plans authorizing this tree placement in the restricted zone. Plans must include explicit written Austin Energy approval if trees are to be planted within clearance-restricted areas.
